components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-+0-9() ]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when supplied. When present it must be four digits and, for a city in a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given."
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional; defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it determines the owner's age band as at their registration date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares its household (same last name and postcode); the new owner is created as a declared household member and bypasses the household duplicate block. Write-only; accepted on input but never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: "The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>': the canonical region derived from the postcode (falling back to the city), a hyphen, and the first eight upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized telephone concatenated with the last name, assigned at creation."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: "A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: "Stable shared identifier for owners who share a household (same last name and postcode): the first twelve hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized last name and postcode, so every such owner resolves to the same value automatically. Null when the owner has no postcode."
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: "The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: "The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>': the customer code, '-M', and the last two digits of the registration date year (e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26')."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "The owner's membership level, from 1 to 3: starts at 1, plus 1 when the owner has an email address, plus 1 when the owner had no namesakes at creation (namesakeCount is 0), capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The owner's locality: the canonical region carried in the '<REGION>-<HASH8>' customer code, derived at creation by preferring the postcode range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) and falling back to the fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' otherwise."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "Whether this owner was part of a bulk signup: true when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's registration date at the moment it was created, false otherwise."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "The owner's age band as at their registration date: 'MINOR' for under 18, 'ADULT' for 18 to 64, or 'SENIOR' for 65 and over. Present only when a birth date is recorded. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "A composite fingerprint: the normalized telephone, the email (or empty when absent) and the household id (or empty when none), joined by '|'. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: "Whether this owner resembles an existing one: true when, at creation, it shared an existing owner's household (same last name and postcode) while having a different telephone and was not a declared household member, false otherwise. A declared member (created with 'sharesHousehold') is a genuine member, not a suspected duplicate. When true, 'possibleDuplicateOf' holds that owner's id."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: "The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same last name and postcode, different telephone), or null when 'possibleDuplicate' is false."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

All references are consistent, and the PUT pipeline never touched `householdId` (out of scope for this create-owner change). The implementation is complete and the build is green.

## Summary

I made the `householdId` deterministic — the first 12 hex chars of SHA-256 over `normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode` — and reshaped everything that keys off the household to use it.

**Core logic** — `Households` (the shared helper):
- `idFor(lastName, postcode)` now hashes `(normalizedLastName, postcode)` instead of `(lastName, address)`, returning `null` when there's no postcode (no postcode → no household).
- `membersOf(...)` now finds existing owners by matching that computed `householdId`, so it's robust to legacy/seed owners with a null stored id.

**Pipeline steps** (`owners.POST.yml`):
- `AssignHouseholdId` now *always* computes and assigns the deterministic id from the owner's last name and postcode — no longer conditional on `sharesHousehold`, and no longer mutates other owners (the link is now automatic).
- The duplicate block was reframed from identity-key to household: `EnsureUniqueIdentityKey` → **`EnsureUniqueHousehold`**, which throws a **`DuplicateHouseholdException`** (409, replacing `DuplicateIdentityKeyException` + handler + escalation YAML) when an existing owner shares the household — **unless** the request sets `sharesHousehold`, which bypasses it and creates a declared member.
- `AssignOwnerPossibleDuplicate` now keys off `householdId` and **skips declared members** (`sharesHousehold`), so a declared member is never flagged as a suspected duplicate.
- `AssignOwnerHouseholdSize` counts members by the computed `householdId` (postcode) rather than address.

**Docs**: updated the `Owner` javadocs and `openapi.yml` descriptions (`householdId`, `sharesHousehold`, `possibleDuplicate`, `possibleDuplicateOf`, `identityKey`) to match the new behavior. I kept `Owner.getIdentityKey()` since it's still an exposed response field, but it no longer drives duplicate detection.

Build compiles and the test suite is green (`Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`), including the new `coreSameLastNameAndPostcodeShareHouseholdId` test — where owner A (first, no opt-in), owner B (same last name+postcode, `sharesHousehold` to bypass the 409), and owner C (different last name) all create successfully, A and B share a `householdId`, and C's differs.
